organization: Secretaría General de Protección Civil y Emergencias
identified_problem: Spain's 2024 Valencia DANA floods and recurring summer wildfires place enormous operational demands on the national civil-protection system. The Secretaría General de Protección Civil y Emergencias, part of the Ministry of the Interior, leads the Sistema Nacional de Protección Civil and therefore needs real-time, location-specific flood and wildfire intelligence to coordinate warnings, evacuations and inter-agency response.
climate_exposure: The agency manages national emergency planning and operational response for floods, wildfires and other natural disasters across all 17 autonomous communities and the central administration.
potential_pain: Delayed or imprecise hazard mapping can slow evacuation decisions, strain response resources and increase casualties and infrastructure damage during fast-evolving DANA or wildfire events.
evidence: Talaix real-time flood and wildfire monitoring layers and historical DANA 2024 event intelligence for Spain.
relevant_capability: Real-time monitoring, alerts and historical event intelligence for flood and wildfire emergency management.
recommended_message: Equip national civil protection with Talaix flood and wildfire monitoring and alerting to shorten warning times during the next DANA or wildfire outbreak.
fit_score: Very high fit: the national emergency-management body directly responsible for coordinating Spain's response to floods and wildfires; real-time hazard intelligence maps exactly to its mandate.

interactions.summary: Identified via official-source research; signal: proteccioncivil.es publishes civil-protection alerts, DANA victim helplines and wildfire-prevention campaigns, and the Quiénes somos page confirms the National School of Civil Protection is part of the Secretaría General de Protección Civil y Emergencias.
